_about: Grid placement (scripts/camp/camp_build.gd). Things are built on a grid of grid_m metres, ahead_m in front of the builder, turned in quarter turns. kinds: what can be built, its model (data/models.json), its footprint size [x, z] in metres before turning, and its cost in coins; packing it away refunds the full cost (the cozy contract). Nothing is built over another building, within object_gap_m of a movable thing, over scenery (blockers: model -> radius in metres), or past the camp edge (data/tuning.json carry.camp_radius_m). Each player can undo their own last undo_depth building steps; the list is cleared each night. ghost is the preview: the model dithered by fade, over a thin tile (thick_m, lifted lift_m above the ground so it shows over the model) tinted ok or blocked (palette swatches) at alpha.
